mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_id, product_id, quantity, added_at) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{addedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId}
DELETE ci FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.product_id = #{productId}
DELETE ci FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, ci.cart_item_id, ci.product_id, ci.quantity, ci.added_at FROM cart c LEFT JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
